column3: NKJV has “a Lamb … having His Father's name,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lamb … having His name and His Father's name.”
NKJV includes “before the throne of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV includes “city,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
